entries.en: You were confined to your cell[n]for so long. Now, at last, it seems[n]only right that you bear its key.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: In the past, guests of the Velvet[n]Room have received their keys[n]upon their very first visits.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: However, I was unable to pass it[n]on to you at that point. This is[n]the least I can do for you now...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: With this key in hand, you will be[n]able to break free of whatever trials[n]may imprison you in the future.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Though of course, you have already[n]chosen the path of true freedom.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: By inspiring others to take up arms,[n]and fight for their own beliefs...[n]you may change the world itself.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You walk the path of a true[n]Trickster. May it lead you to[n]fortune beyond imagining.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You walk the path of a true Trickster.[n]May it lead you to fortune beyond[n]imagining.
